notes.title: SUFFER 1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
SUFFER 1.5 Patch Notes

[list]
[*] Implemented Steam Cloud Save Support!
[*] Implemented 3D audio
[*] Updated to use more polished sprites from SUFFER 2
[*] Fix long standing bug with music engine 
[*] Added missing 'Anarchy' to Challenge Level 2 (Thanks Roman for pointing that out!)
[/list]

notes.title: SUFFER 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-VDo2PLDiJNk/XapabH4wYXI/AAAAAAAACHY/Qg0fFgcnsVwumC8V0g9kcMrgHblAy26CgCLcBGAsYHQ/s1600/suffer1.gif][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-VDo2PLDiJNk/XapabH4wYXI/AAAAAAAACHY/Qg0fFgcnsVwumC8V0g9kcMrgHblAy26CgCLcBGAsYHQ/s400/suffer1.gif[/img][/url]

Hey friends,

I'm happy to announce that SUFFER patch 1.4 is officially live! This update is a "thank you" note to all of you wonderful people who've supported me and my game. I've added in a trio of challenge levels for those who want to come back to SUFFER some more! The patch contains the following:

[list][*]Challenge Mode - 3 all-new levels for the diehard [/*][*]4 more Steam Achievements[/*][*]Various Performance fixes[/*][*]Riot Police sprite is brighter / easier to see[/*][*]Fixed Demon Lord hurt animation[/*][/list]

Thank you!

tags.feature: Challenge Mode - 3 all-new levels for the diehard
Riot Police sprite is brighter / easier to see

notes.title: SUFFER 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-AwnXtxnL900/XWCr78WxFKI/AAAAAAAACGs/PC_WmBSOC0I41xzb1kVvn9G0NtGFsR9rACLcBGAs/s1600/suffer3.gif][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-AwnXtxnL900/XWCr78WxFKI/AAAAAAAACGs/PC_WmBSOC0I41xzb1kVvn9G0NtGFsR9rACLcBGAs/s640/suffer3.gif[/img][/url]
I'm proud to announce that SUFFER has been patched to version 1.3! This is a pretty large update, adding performance improvements, new features, and graphical updates!


[list][*]Two all-new difficulty modes: Casual and Brutal[/*][*]Three additional achievements[/*][*]Brand new hidden weapon - the Plasma Hand Cannon![/*][*]Graphic updates / animation improvements[/*][*]Additional scene decals[/*][*]Gameplay balance tweaks (Hitscanner enemies have reduced accuracy, by popular demand!)[/*][*]Performance improvements[/*][*]Bug fixes[/*][/list]This is a very substantial update, I hope you will enjoy it! Thank you for playing my game! 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950210/SUFFER/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/950210/SUFFER/[/url]

notes.title: SUFFER 1.17 Patch Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

SUFFER has been patched to version 1.17 today. This update fixes a few bugs, but it is mostly a graphical update.

[list][*]Updates to scene lighting [/*][*]Updates to real-time lighting effects[/*][*]Sprites have been touched up [/*][*]Fixed a menu bug [/*][*]Fixed controller weapon switch bug [/*][*]Fixed rocket launcher bug[/*][*]Performance enhancements[/*][/list]This update makes the game much more enjoyable, and I am very happy with how the game looks and runs! Thank you to everyone for your feedback, SUFFER is now better than ever because of you!

notes.title: SUFFER patch v1.11
notes.content:
Hey friends,

The latest SUFFER patch has gone live today.

SUFFER v1.11 addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*]Graphical enhancements, lighting and rendering tweaks[/*]
[*]Gameplay balancing updates[/*]
[*]Improved keybinding functionality[/*]
[*]Fixed bug where users could get stuck in menus[/*]
[*]Fixed a bug in the Chapter 4 Boss fight[/*]
[*]Fixed music looping bug[/*]
[/list]
This is a pretty substantial patch, and I hope it greatly increases your enjoyment of SUFFER! Don't forget to grab your copy while it's on sale for launch week!
